metadata.title: Getting Started
metadata.description: Learn how to install and configure the Capacitor Watch plugin for bidirectional communication between iPhone and Apple Watch.

blocks.text: You can use our AI-Assisted Setup to install the plugin. Add the Capgo skills to your AI tool using the following command:
Use the `capacitor-plugins` skill from `Cap-go/capgo-skills` to install the `@capgo/capacitor-watch` plugin in my project.
If you prefer Manual Setup, install the plugin by running the following commands and follow the platform-specific instructions below:
Add the WatchConnectivity capability to your iOS app in Xcode
Create a watchOS app target in your Xcode project
Implement WatchConnectivity in your watchOS app (see Watch App Implementation below)
The plugin automatically activates the WCSession when the plugin loads.
